tagline: Effortless cuts, lived-in color, and a calm salon experience in New York City.
about: Leeren Salon is where modern minimalism meets masterful hair — clean lines, soft texture, and color that grows out beautifully.
We believe great hair should feel natural, not overdone. Every appointment starts with listening, then tailoring a look that fits your life.
Follow us on Instagram for the latest transformations, styling tips, and appointment openings.
